# HP LIFE

> > HP LIFE is a free global platform offering 30+ online business and digital skills courses with certificates, partnering with organizations like ITU and UNDP to build workforce readiness across developing regions.

HP LIFE (Learning Initiative For Entrepreneurs) is an HP Foundation-supported program that provides accessible, free online education in business skills, digital literacy, and entrepreneurship. The platform serves learners globally through direct courses, mobile apps, and partnerships with educational institutions, nonprofits, and government agencies to drive economic opportunity and digital equity.

- [Free Online Courses to Develop Business Skills | HP LIFE](https://www.life-global.org/allcourses): Complete catalog of 30+ free HP LIFE courses across business skills
- [Download HP LIFE App](https://www.life-global.org/download/app): HP LIFE mobile app download page for accessing learning platform
